Myanmar

Travel Advisory

10 June 2026

In view of the ongoing armed conflict, Singaporeans are strongly advised to defer all travel to Myanmar.

A state of emergency and martial law remains in place in many townships across Myanmar. The security situation can change quickly and without notice.

Singaporeans in Myanmar should consider leaving by commercial means as soon as possible. Protests have been reported in Yangon and Mandalay; avoid large gatherings.

Singaporeans are encouraged to eRegister with MFA at https://eregister.mfa.gov.sg.

Visa information

Singapore ordinary passport holders do not require a tourist visa for stays of up to 30 days. Information last updated on 2 January 2025.
